resolution: Fixed both halves of the freeze (commits 98644a254 + docs). Root cause: the region formula composed the ENTIRE 410-material dispatch (~735 KB WGSL) and the live row bound on the FIRST KEYSTROKE — one typed letter fuzzy-matched a material (your manifest shows it grabbed autumn_leaves) and kicked a minutes-long naga compile on the render thread. Now buildRegionFormula(fns) composes ONLY the bound materials (lava_plasma module = 19.4 KB, sub-second, verified by harness) and the Rig row edits a DRAFT — binding happens on Enter or the bind verb only. Hot-reloads, no host rebuild. The meshdoc refusals were the req_3049/3226 save guard WORKING: it refused to overwrite the 3-part Lavalamp doc with a 1-row outliner (likely mid-hydration during the freeze); the package on disk (Lavalampsad) is intact with all 3 parts. Docs record gains the never-compose-the-catalog hazard.
